name: Romics
blurb: Rome's twice-yearly international festival of comics, animation, cosplay, cinema and games at Fiera Roma.

editions.evidence: AEFI (Associazione Esposizioni e Fiere Italiane) official Italian trade-fair calendar lists Romics 2027 at Fiera Roma, 30 September - 3 October 2027.

notes: Romics runs two editions a year (spring + autumn). The 37th edition just ran Oct 1-4, 2026 (confirmed via press: 'dal 1 al 4 ottobre'), which already ended right before the research window, so it is excluded. Only the autumn 2027 (39th) edition has dates I could verify from an authoritative source (AEFI). A spring 2027 (38th) edition is expected around April per the twice-yearly pattern, but I could not confirm specific dates for it from an official source within budget, so it is left out rather than guessed.
